sql: SELECT a.*,d.details_json,d.scraped_at FROM aoc_tenders a LEFT JOIN aoc_details d USING(internal_id) WHERE a.ref_no IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
limitations: Exact ref_no only. Formatting variants not searched or merged. A zero result cannot disprove an award.
Contractor identity remains separate from dataset labels.
